caption: A large brass singing bowl half full of water is rubbed around its rim with a mallet, and as it sings the water surface breaks into ripples and leaping droplets.

sa.check: A brass singing bowl half full of water.
A mallet is rubbed around the bowl's rim.
The water surface breaks into ripples.
The mallet moves around the rim rather than tapping it.
The rubbing comes first; the ripples and droplets follow.

pc.expect: The water is flat until the mallet moves on the rim; ripples and droplets appear only while it moves and die away when it stops.
pc.fail: Ripples or droplets appear before the mallet touches the rim; or appear with the mallet held away; or the mallet circles the rim and the water stays glassy; or the droplets keep leaping well after the mallet has stopped.

pc.expect: The ripples form a fine pattern across the surface with droplets leaping up from it and falling back; the bowl stays put and does not spill.
pc.fail: The bowl tips or slides while being rubbed; or the water sloshes up one side and spills over; or droplets rise from a single spot while the rest of the surface is glassy; or a single ring spreads from the centre as if something were dropped in.

pc.expect: Droplets fall back into the bowl or onto the table.
pc.fail: Droplets hang in the air; or rise out of view; or droplets that left the bowl come back up into it.

pc.expect: The brass bowl and the mallet are rigid.
pc.fail: The bowl's wall ripples like cloth; or the mallet bends; or the bowl dents under the mallet.

pc.expect: One bowl, one mallet; the water keeps its amount.
pc.fail: A second bowl appears; or the mallet passes through the bowl wall; or the water vanishes; or the bowl changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The bowl's colour and engraving, the mallet and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The bowl changes colour or its engraving changes; or the mallet changes length; or the table changes.

note: The hand on the mallet is a trigger and is not judged.
